title: A selected mark's halo is painted under the mark beside it
foundBy: repository owner, reading a consuming page: "when selecting a circle, it gets cut off on the top and the rhs side ... on the rhs because the next circle covers it"
details: EventLanes paints marks in index order, in both layouts, and each mark paints its own halos first. A mark selected next to a close neighbour therefore has the right part of its halo covered by the neighbour, and the ring reads as cut off. On a consuming page a row of log claims spread twelve pixels apart showed it on every selection.
